items.title: Two Sri Lankans killed in road accident in South Korea
items.summary: Two Sri Lankan nationals have died following a road accident in Hwaseong-si, South Korea, on November 26, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism confirmed.

items.title: Police open fire on van carrying robbery suspects in Eheliyagoda
items.summary: Police opened fire on a van carrying a group of suspects allegedly involved in a robbery in Parakaduwa, Eheliyagoda, as they attempted to flee the area.

items.title: Colpetty circular Metro bus service to be suspended from December 1
items.summary: Lanka Metro Transit (LMT) has announced the temporary suspension of its CM06 Colpetty circular bus service with effect from December 1.

items.title: Indian police dismantle international cyber fraud ring, rescue 164 foreigners
items.summary: Delhi police said they rescued 164 foreign nationals who were allegedly held against their will and forced to commit online fraud, foreign media reported.

items.title: Heavy showers of over 100mm expected in several provinces
